title: Boundary integral equation based solvers for elastic transmission problems in complex media
summary: We present a boundary integral equation (BIE) framework for two-dimensional time-harmonic elastic transmission problems. Using the Helmholtz decomposition, the elastodynamic displacement fields are expressed in terms of scalar pressure and shear potentials, so that only the four classical Helmholtz boundary integral operators are needed. The key step is a rewriting of the Navier traction operator in the local normal--tangential frame of the interface, in which second-order normal derivatives are eliminated in favour of tangential derivatives and curvature terms.
